labels: the builder (Opus) from the patch spike's and the window spike's measurements (their READMEs), the record's decisions, and the arithmetic in the work folder's FIRST_STEP.md; 'measured-before' cites the spike; a guess says so

dtype: float32 (gate 12 and the dtype arms of gates 2 and 9)
operating_point.platform: GitHub runner, 4 vCPU, CPU; probes on probe/* branches; no Modal
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: MIME's MRS sphere of radius a = 1 mm (tests/lubrication_cases.py's), viscosity 1 mPa s, spacings 0.25 a (338 force points, MIME's default) and 0.1 a; the fine cell a/20 (rule 2: 20 fine cells across the radius) unless stated; the patch the sphere plus 8 fine cells a side (56^3); the plane z = 0 on the fine lattice's faces, the sphere's centre (0.37, 0.21) fine cells off the lattice laterally; the patch CG at 1e-8 (float64) and 1e-5 at its floor (float32); GMRES to 1e-9 right-preconditioned by the free part's LU; the shell 4 fine cells into the solid
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: gate 4: 200 draws of coarse fields, given values, origins up to 3 coarse cells off, at unit scale; gate 11: positions between snaps at sub-cell steps of 1/8

gate_1_plane_oracle.claim: the patch alone with the plane's exact boundary values reproduces the window spike's patch share: the normal entry's share by the gap in fine cells at 20 cells across the radius
gate_1_plane_oracle.kind: estimates (the patch's own band against the same MRS with the exact image read at the force points)
gate_1_plane_oracle.case: tests/patch/patch_cases.py: Case(spacing 0.25 and 0.1, cells 20, gap 0.1/0.15/0.2/0.3 a), resistance() with patch_reader against image_reader('point'), Brenner

prediction.unit: % of the exact normal entry at 2 fine cells (0.1 a); [-2.0, -1.2] at 3 (0.15 a); [-0.8, -0.3] at 4 (0.2 a); along the wall and the rotation within 0.4 % of their own scale
prediction.why: the band in fine cells (window q3), set by the gap in cells and growing slowly with the radius in cells

gate_1_plane_oracle.metric: (K_patch - K_image) / K_exact on the normal column

control.plant: PATCH_PLANT=no_source: the forces' own Stokeslets left out of the patch (its near-wall reflection only what its faces carry)
control.expected_rate: N/N at every gap of 4 fine cells or less
control.resolution: the share's line at each gap is 2 points beyond the prediction's band; the plant reads beyond -20 % [guess]

gate_1_plane_oracle.if_wrong: a share beyond the band at 20 cells means the kind differs from the spike's patch (read, band resampling, lift); compared arm by arm with the 8-cell smoke and the spike's q3
gate_1_plane_oracle.cannot_discriminate_if: the gap is beyond about 6 fine cells (the share is under the oracle's 0.1 % then)

gate_2_tube_tables.claim: in the straight periodic tube at D/h 16 the patch (F2, trilinear) reproduces the patch spike's tables at ratios 4 (12- and 20-cell patches) and 8 (16-cell patch) within their spread
gate_2_tube_tables.kind: estimates against dev1's tube table through MIME at the true positions (the table's own 0.6 to 1 % on the axis)
gate_2_tube_tables.case: the steady loop's test harness (tests/patch/): the coarse flux-free tube, the cluster's own free box removed, the patch, GMRES

prediction.unit: points from the spike's entry at each position (ratio 4 trilinear npc 12: -1.9 at 4.8 fine cells a/R 0.1, -4.3 at 2.56; ratio 8 trilinear npc 16: -1.3 to -1.9 at 5.1 to 9.6, -3.3 and -6.7 at 5.1), both dtypes (float32 within 0.1 point of float64)
prediction.why: the same discrete problem as the spike's patch (F2, the trilinear read, the lift, the band resampled); the coarse solve is MIME's own

gate_2_tube_tables.metric: the normal and axial K over the free MRS sphere's, against the table at the same position

control.plant: the body placed 0.37 coarse cells nearer the wall than its table reference (R2's error)
control.expected_rate: N/N at the positions within 2.4 coarse cells of the wall
control.resolution: the offset moved the spike's entries by 7 to 19 points

gate_2_tube_tables.if_wrong: a miss larger than the spread: the coarse floor or the free box's removal differs from the spike's; read on the axis first
gate_2_tube_tables.cannot_discriminate_if: the position is on the axis (the wall outside the patch: the patch only passes the coarse error through)

gate_3_no_recompile.claim: 50 steps with the patch's origin snapping trace the patch's functions once
gate_3_no_recompile.case: a jitted scan of 50 placements and reflections with the origin moving 18 times, node_measure.py's trace counter

prediction.why: the shape is the kind's; the origin, the dilation and the walls are values

control.plant: a patch two cells larger fed to the same program

gate_3_no_recompile.if_wrong: a value in a shape or a Python branch on a traced value
gate_3_no_recompile.cannot_discriminate_if: the origin never moves in the run

gate_4_transfers_transpose.claim: the two transfers (coarse field to the patch's given values; the patch's field to the read points, point and cell) are an exact transpose pair
gate_4_transfers_transpose.case: drawn coarse fields on a periodic MAC grid and an open one, given values, origins, points; <B x, y> against <x, B^T y>

prediction.why: one stencil gives both; the sums differ only in their order

gate_4_transfers_transpose.if_wrong: an index or weight differs between the read and its spread
gate_4_transfers_transpose.cannot_discriminate_if: a drawn field is constant (both sides then agree for any wrong weights summing to one)

gate_5_snapped_motion.claim: a snap moves the coupled resistance by about 1e-4 of itself, and between snaps the derivative is smooth: the wobble metric at or below 1e-3 with whole-cell openings
gate_5_snapped_motion.case: the plane oracle at 20 fine cells, the sphere moved in 1/8-cell steps over two cells along and toward the wall

prediction.unit: the snap's jump over K; the wobble metric (period-one amplitude of dB/dl over its mean) 1e-4 to 1e-3
prediction.why: the wall stays on the lattice between snaps; the read's kinks average over hundreds of force points

gate_5_snapped_motion.metric: the jump at a snap over K; the period-one amplitude of the derivative

control.plant: a continuous wall offset (the patch's lattice moving through the wall's band)
control.resolution: the window spike measured 0.48 continuous, 1e-3 on the lattice

gate_5_snapped_motion.if_wrong: the wall resampling moves with the body between snaps
gate_5_snapped_motion.cannot_discriminate_if: the sweep spans less than one fine cell

gate_6_dilation_blend.claim: the reflection blended between the two whole-cell dilations is continuous across whole cells and its derivative in the dilation is carried
gate_6_dilation_blend.case: blended_reflection across whole cells of the dilation; the derivative against central differences

prediction.unit: relative jump of the blended value across a whole cell
prediction.why: at a whole cell the weight is zero or one and both sides evaluate the same placement

gate_6_dilation_blend.metric: the jump; the derivative's agreement with central differences
gate_6_dilation_blend.if_wrong: the weight or the floor taken from a held value
gate_6_dilation_blend.cannot_discriminate_if: the two placements' reflections are equal (no wall in the patch)

gate_7_one_uniform_offset.claim: one uniform dilation per patch holds two-wall pairs at h_m <= 0.1 R within the measured 6.4 %
gate_7_one_uniform_offset.case: the patch between two planes, one uniform dilation, against the per-contact form at the same pairs

prediction.unit: % worst entry at h_m 0.1 R; at 0.15 R beyond 7 % at most pairs
prediction.why: the window spike's q6; the patch does not change which contact is opened

gate_7_one_uniform_offset.metric: the worst entry's error on its own scale
gate_7_one_uniform_offset.if_wrong: the dilation is not uniform over the patch's walls
gate_7_one_uniform_offset.cannot_discriminate_if: only one contact is within the dilation's reach (uniform and per-contact are then the same)

gate_8_read_near_contact.claim: the chosen read's normal overshoot at 0.1 to 0.15 a sits under the first step's line (5 %)
gate_8_read_near_contact.kind: estimates (the image arm: the MRS with the exact image read by each form, against Brenner)
gate_8_read_near_contact.case: tests/patch/patch_cases.py image_reader('point' | 'cell' | 'source') and the patch arm with each read, spacings 0.25 a and 0.1 a, gaps 0.1/0.15/0.2/0.3 a

prediction.unit: % normal overshoot of the cell read at 0.1 a, spacing 0.25 a; [1, 5] at 0.15 a; the cell and source reads within 1 point of each other; at 0.1 a spacing the cell read [0.5, 3] at 0.1 a
prediction.basis: guess (C3's 0.5 s line came from S4's integrated image; 0.1 a is 0.4 s)
prediction.why: integrating over the cell removes the point read's near-wall singular sampling

control.plant: the point read at the default spacing
control.expected_rate: reads beyond +50 % at 0.1 a, every run

gate_8_read_near_contact.if_wrong: the cell read does not reach 5 % at 0.25 a: the fallback, a finer spacing near contact, is measured at 0.1 a
gate_8_read_near_contact.cannot_discriminate_if: the gap is 0.3 a or more (every read within a few per cent there)

gate_9_warm_start.claim: the warm-started patch solve gives the cold answer to the solve's tolerance on every step, and takes fewer iterations
gate_9_warm_start.case: the plane oracle's GMRES products cold and warm (from the last product; from the last step's field shifted by a snap)

prediction.unit: warm iterations over cold for a step's first product warm from the last step; [0.5, 1.0] for a later product warm from the last product
prediction.why: the start is the Galerkin multiple of the last field: a Krylov direction is nearly orthogonal to it

gate_9_warm_start.metric: the true residual of each warm solve; iterations

control.plant: least_iterations 0 (a warm start within the tolerance accepted with no iteration)
control.expected_rate: N/N by the true residual on a start that is not the answer
control.resolution: the true residual against the tolerance

gate_9_warm_start.if_wrong: the warm start is worse than cold: the shift at a snap is wrong
gate_9_warm_start.cannot_discriminate_if: the start is already the answer (then accepting it is right)

gate_10_in_time.claim: the quasi-steady patch's force history against a fine monolithic backward-Euler reference on a sphere given a step change of force near a plane
gate_10_in_time.case: the steady loop's harness stepped in time: (i) the coarse grid at the fine cell, (ii) coarse plus the quasi-steady patch

prediction.unit: relative force error after 3 to 5 relaxation times; 0.1 to 0.4 of the wall's share in the first 2 to 5 ms
prediction.why: the near field is steady Stokes; the patch's history matters only in transients on the reflection's diffusion time

gate_10_in_time.metric: the force's relative error over time

control.plant: none for the quasi-steady form (it carries no field); the slab left unfilled only if a backward-Euler patch is chosen

gate_10_in_time.if_wrong: beyond the band after 5 relaxation times: the backward-Euler patch, re-sized
gate_10_in_time.cannot_discriminate_if: the step change is slower than the diffusion time over the box (both forms then agree by construction)

gate_11_gradients.claim: the reflection's derivative in the body's position between snaps agrees with central differences in float64; the snap's jump declared
gate_11_gradients.case: jax.jvp of the coupled normal force (or the first reflection) in the body's position at sub-cell positions, against central differences at 1e-6 cells

prediction.why: linear solves under custom_linear_solve; the read and the Stokeslets are smooth in the points between lattice planes

control.resolution: the read's share of the derivative, above 1e-3 of it [guess]

gate_11_gradients.if_wrong: a points' dependence held as a constant (the snapped origin's is, by design)
gate_11_gradients.cannot_discriminate_if: a difference step crosses a lattice plane of a force point's read (a kink)

gate_12_float32.claim: the patch's CG floor in float32 stated; its stops flagged, never silent; float32's reflection within a stated line of float64's
gate_12_float32.case: the plane oracle and the patch solve in float32 at 56^3

prediction.unit: the float32 true residual reached (its floor); the reflection within 1e-4 relative of float64's (band 1e-6 to 1e-4)
prediction.basis: measured-before (the FVM's FLOOR_MEASURED at D/h 16 to 64)
prediction.why: the solve's rounding floor eps |A||x| at about n = 56

gate_12_float32.metric: the report's residual; the relative difference

control.plant: a tolerance below the floor without at_floor

gate_12_float32.cannot_discriminate_if: float64 run under the float32 label
